name: target_auto
description: The auto-target mask of a forced action: the side (argument, or the command bit when negative; a party user reads non-zero as own side, a monster user as the other way round), then single (stream 4), group (stream 5), all or self.

function.signature: u32 auto_target(int user, int cmdId, int side)

harness.note: the real machine code of the function in an x86-32 emulator; battle generator scripted (stream and value recorded); queue inserts and animation requests hooked

notes: The vector class is the command target type (type0 single, type1 group, type2 all, type3 self).
